restored_constant_rate.formula: The slope fitted through zero to nominal cup volume against acknowledged board-on seconds, multiplied by total planned on-seconds. It has no allowance for a restart, pause or valve opening.
restored_constant_rate.rulers: Direct right glass marks and independently projected left marks share the same cup. The two predictions show volume-scale sensitivity. Each middle-80 band resamples whole archived shots in paired ruler measurements and propagates slope uncertainty. Neither band covers future individual-pour variation, common cup accuracy, geometry changes or transfer between rigs.

engineering_dead_time.formula: For each engineering prior draw, sum rate_ml_min * max(0, width_ms - loss_ms) / 60000 across all planned gates. All gates of the pour share the same rate and loss. Use the exact seeded model quantiles.
engineering_dead_time.distribution: Independent uniform engineering inputs. Rate = 600 * spread * (supply_V - drop_V - armature_V) / (12 - armature_V) * (1 - slip). Ranges: spread 0.9–1.1, supply 11.8–12.2 V, drop 0.5–1.0 V, armature 2.5–5 V, slip 0–0.03, loss per gate 10–40 ms.
engineering_dead_time.interpretation: These are engineering-parameter prior quantiles, shared by the heads. They are not calibrated bounds on future measurements. The model subtracts spin-up even when firmware briefly parks at the transition of a nominal continuous ratio cycle.
